description: Relics are exceptional magical items. They are normally acquired through major adventures, powerful enemies, ancient ruins, or important narrative events. Relic prices represent battlefield value rather than ordinary market availability.

relics.name: Blade of the Falling Star
relics.effect: When the Attack Surges, one Critical Hit may deal +1 Damage.
notes: This is the weapon's complete Point cost, not an enchantment added to another weapon.

relics.name: Aegis of the First King
relics.effect: Counts as a Shield. Improve Armor by 1 step. Gain Ward 5+ against Magic.

command.name: Hold the Line
command.effect: When you or an ally within 2" is targeted by a non-Instant Attack, affected friendly Units within 2" of you gain Tough 2 against the triggering Attack.

relics.name: Crown of Command
relics.effect: Increase the Range of friendly-targeted Command Abilities by 2". Once per Round, reduce the CP cost of one Command Ability targeting an ally by 1, to a minimum of 0.

relics.name: Staff of the Archmage
relics.effect: Choose one Spell Attack. That Attack gains: +2" Range; +1 Attack die. Once per Round, when making a Spell Attack, replace one normal successful Hit with Direct Damage 1 against the target. Ward applies normally.

command.name: Masterful Casting
command.effect: Your next Spell Attack this Turn gains Accurate 2.

relics.name: Saint's Reliquary
relics.effect: Gain Ward 5+ against Magic. Once per Round, when Healing another Unit, Heal 1 Wound to yourself.

command.name: Greater Miracle
command.effect: Choose up to three friendly Units within Short Range. Heal 1 Wound to each selected Unit. This cannot restore removed Models.
